 Christian Braun deserves his flowers for his impact on the Nuggets' defense 
 Christian Braun's defense has been next-level for the Nuggets over the first 13 games. By David Decker | Nov 19, 2026, 5:00 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Sep 28, 2026; Denver, CO, USA; Denver Nuggets guard Christian Braun (0) during media day at Ball Arena. Mandatory Credit: Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Critics and fans of the Denver Nuggets alike have been pretty hard on Christian Braun over the past year. Many a bad thing has been said about the Nuggets' starting two-guard. You can still say it about his three-point shooting, unfortunately, but you have to give him his flowers in every other way, as he's doing everything else his role requires at a top-flight level. Especially his defense.
--> Critics and fans of the Denver Nuggets alike have been pretty hard on Christian Braun over the past year. Many a bad thing has been said about the Nuggets' starting two-guard. You can still say it about his three-point shooting, unfortunately, but you have to give him his flowers in every other way, as he's doing everything else his role requires at a top-flight level. Especially his defense.
 Braun missed 38 games last season due to an ankle injury, and he never looked like the Braun who played defense and performed his role well enough to entice the Nuggets into that five-year, $125 million contract extension he received. He was never fully healthy, and his defense really suffered from it. Braun went from 1.1 to 0.7 steals per game, and his inability to pressure opposing guards and wings led to too many layups in the paint.
--> Braun missed 38 games last season due to an ankle injury, and he never looked like the Braun who played defense and performed his role well enough to entice the Nuggets into that five-year, $125 million contract extension he received. He was never fully healthy, and his defense really suffered from it. Braun went from 1.1 to 0.7 steals per game, and his inability to pressure opposing guards and wings led to too many layups in the paint.
 Those issues are well behind Braun this season. Head coach David Adelman said during the preseason that Braun had his "explosion" back, and he was spot on about that read.
--> Those issues are well behind Braun this season. Head coach David Adelman said during the preseason that Braun had his "explosion" back, and he was spot on about that read.
 Braun's defense has been incredible compared to last year
--> Braun's defense has been incredible compared to last year
 I think many Nuggets fans thought the Nuggets were fully duped into Braun's huge extension, and that his breakout year of 2024-25 was a fluke. Clearly, that is not the case this year. Braun started out the season as part of the defensive group that held Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in the opening game against the OKC Thunder to just 17 points, the first time SGA had been held under 20 points in 141 games. And Braun hasn't looked back.
--> I think many Nuggets fans thought the Nuggets were fully duped into Braun's huge extension, and that his breakout year of 2024-25 was a fluke. Clearly, that is not the case this year. Braun started out the season as part of the defensive group that held Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in the opening game against the OKC Thunder to just 17 points, the first time SGA had been held under 20 points in 141 games. And Braun hasn't looked back.
 Braun showed in the Nuggets' 105-101 win over the Celtics that he can even take on larger wings, and he had a key steal on Jayson Tatum as the game was winding down. In fact, Braun's third in the entire NBA with 2.2 steals per game. Braun was so impactful guarding Tatum in the second half that Tatum had more turnovers than points over the game's final 24 minutes.
--> Braun showed in the Nuggets' 105-101 win over the Celtics that he can even take on larger wings, and he had a key steal on Jayson Tatum as the game was winding down. In fact, Braun's third in the entire NBA with 2.2 steals per game. Braun was so impactful guarding Tatum in the second half that Tatum had more turnovers than points over the game's final 24 minutes.
 Braun's been active in the passing lanes, and the added pressure he's been applying, plus his quickness to get in front of the offensive player, have been one of the reasons the Nuggets are allowing 47.8 points in the paint versus 50.7 per game last year.
--> Braun's been active in the passing lanes, and the added pressure he's been applying, plus his quickness to get in front of the offensive player, have been one of the reasons the Nuggets are allowing 47.8 points in the paint versus 50.7 per game last year.
 Braun could be the most important role player on the team
--> Braun could be the most important role player on the team
 The Nuggets are full of role players, and Braun could be their most important role player so far. Braun is third on the team in scoring at 12.8 points per game. He's been active in the cutting lanes and has been on the receiving end of some great passes from his teammates for easy finishes at the rim.
--> The Nuggets are full of role players, and Braun could be their most important role player so far. Braun is third on the team in scoring at 12.8 points per game. He's been active in the cutting lanes and has been on the receiving end of some great passes from his teammates for easy finishes at the rim.
 If only he could knock an open three down. He said he put in the work to improve his performance from last year, but so far he's shooting just 31.7% from beyond the arc after a 1-for-9 effort against the Celtics. With opposing teams leaving him open to double Jamal Murray or Nikola Jokic, finding that three-point shot becomes super important. If those start falling, Braun will absolutely be living up to his contract and then some.
